We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Cluster Painter & Polisher to join our Engineering team, supporting both Dukes The Palm Dubai Hotel and NH Collection Dubai The Palm.

The successful candidate will be responsible for carrying out painting, polishing, surface restoration, and general finishing works across both properties, ensuring that guest rooms, public areas, back-of-house facilities, and hotel assets are maintained to the highest standards of quality, safety, and presentation.
q: Minimum 2 years of relevant experience as a Painter, Polisher, or similar position, preferably within a 4- or 5-star hotel environment.
Practical knowledge of painting techniques, wood polishing, varnishing, and surface restoration.
Experience working with different types of paints, finishes, and polishing materials.
Ability to perform minor repairs and finishing works independently.
Basic understanding of workplace health and safety standards.
Good attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality workmanship.
Ability to prioritize tasks and work efficiently across two hotel properties.
Good communication skills and ability to work effectively within a multicultural team.
Flexible, reliable, and willing to support operational requirements.
Join our Cluster Engineering team and help us maintain safe, efficient, and exceptional hotel environments for our guests and team members!
Not the right fit? Set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!
r: Perform painting, polishing, varnishing, staining, and surface finishing works throughout both hotel properties.
Prepare surfaces by cleaning, sanding, filling cracks, applying primers, and ensuring proper finishing.
Carry out touch-up painting and refurbishment of guest rooms, corridors, public areas, offices, and back-of-house facilities.
Polish and restore wooden furniture, doors, fixtures, and other decorative surfaces.
Identify and repair minor surface defects, including scratches, dents, cracks, and damaged finishes.
Ensure proper mixing, application, and storage of paints, varnishes, polishing materials, and chemicals.
Conduct regular inspections and preventive maintenance to maintain the appearance and condition of hotel facilities.
Respond promptly to maintenance requests and complete assigned tasks within established timelines.
Maintain tools, equipment, and work areas in a clean, safe, and organized condition.
Follow hotel health, safety, and environmental procedures, including the proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
Coordinate with the Engineering team and other departments to minimize disruption to hotel operations and guest experiences.
Support refurbishment projects and other Engineering-related assignments across both properties as required.

d: Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.

QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.

QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard & Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3) and Fitch (A+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.

Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.

d: Help AG is looking for a Senior Security Engineer – WAF & Application Security with strong hands-on experience in Web Application Firewall (WAF), Application Security and WAAP technologies. The role will primarily focus on Cloudflare Application Security, including WAF, DDoS Protection, Bot Management, API Security and application onboarding. The engineer will also provide operational and technical support for F5 Advanced WAF/ASM, Akamai WAF and Imperva WAF environments.

The role requires strong troubleshooting, policy tuning, security rule management, incident handling, application onboarding and L3 operational support capabilities across enterprise WAF environments.
WAF Managed Rules and Custom Rules
IP, ASN, Geo and reputation-based controls
WAF policy tuning and false-positive management
Security event analysis and traffic investigation
Cloudflare Zero Trust/security services exposure is an advantage
WAF policy tuning and false-positive handling
F5 Distributed Cloud WAF/XC – added advantage
q: 6+ years of experience in Network Security / Cybersecurity, with strong hands-on experience in WAF and Application Security.
ITIL / security certifications such as CISSP, CEH, GIAC, or relevant vendor certifications are an advantage.
Strong hands-on experience with Cloudflare WAF/Application Security is mandatory.
Good working experience with at least one or more of F5 Advanced WAF/ASM, Akamai WAF or Imperva WAF.
Strong understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, SSL/TLS, TCP/IP, web application architecture, reverse proxy concepts and load balancing.
Understanding of CDN concepts and application traffic flows.
Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10 and common web application attack techniques.
Experience in WAF policy creation, tuning, troubleshooting and false-positive analysis.
Experience with application onboarding and production traffic migration.
Strong incident management and troubleshooting skills.
Experience working in a 24x7 managed security / SOC / MSSP environment is an advantage.
Excellent understanding of web application traffic and security threats.
Ability to analyze WAF logs and identify attack patterns.
Ability to handle critical production incidents and security escalations.
Good understanding of change, incident and problem management processes.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical issues.
Willingness to mentor junior engineers and contribute to team knowledge development.
r: Lead and execute WAF and Application Security solution design and implementation activities, with primary focus on Cloudflare WAF/WAAP.
Design WAF security architecture and traffic flows for internet-facing applications, APIs, CDN and hybrid/cloud environments.
Develop and implement Cloudflare WAF security policies, managed/custom rules, rate limiting, bot controls, API security and DDoS protection based on application requirements.
Design and implement application onboarding, DNS routing, SSL/TLS configuration and production traffic migration/cutover plans.
Translate application security requirements into WAF policies and protection controls while balancing security, performance and application availability.
Perform WAF policy planning, rule staging, testing, validation and controlled production deployment.
Participate in technical discussions with application, network, cloud and architecture teams to define WAF implementation designs and security requirements.
Prepare high-level and low-level implementation designs, configuration standards, implementation plans, rollback plans and technical documentation.
Lead implementation and migration activities across Cloudflare and, where required, F5 Advanced WAF/ASM, Akamai and Imperva WAF platforms.
Provide L2/L3 operational support for enterprise WAF and Application Security platforms.
Manage day-to-day Cloudflare WAF operations, including application onboarding, policy configuration, rule creation and tuning.
Analyze WAF events, security alerts and HTTP traffic to identify malicious and legitimate traffic.
Perform WAF policy tuning and false-positive analysis while maintaining application availability.
Configure and maintain Cloudflare WAF managed/custom rules, rate limiting, bot controls and application security policies.
Support DDoS mitigation and application-layer attack investigations.
Troubleshoot HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, TLS, application connectivity and traffic-flow issues.
Perform security rule analysis based on OWASP Top 10 and common web application attacks.
Investigate and resolve WAF-related incidents, service requests and security events within defined SLAs.
Work closely with application, network, cloud and SOC teams during security incidents and application onboarding.
Perform WAF health checks, configuration reviews and security posture assessments.
Review WAF policies and recommend improvements to application security controls.
Support WAF upgrades, migrations, configuration changes and platform maintenance.
Perform root-cause analysis and prepare RCA reports for major incidents.
Maintain technical documentation, configuration records, SOPs and knowledge articles.
Participate in change management, maintenance windows and planned security improvements.
Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and support team knowledge development.
Participate in customer meetings and provide technical recommendations related to WAF and Application Security.
